task.title: HANGS Construction · October 2026 Bank Reconciliation
task.description: Reconcile HANGS Construction's operating account at Cobalt Harbor Bank (x4417) to GL 1010 for October 2026: the bank statement and check images against the cash register, the GL cash balances, the signed September reconciliation and the HANGS Cash Procedures. Ties the opening balances, matches every deposit and every check and payment, lists outstanding checks and deposits in transit, finds the bank-only items and any amount recorded wrong, and proves the reconciliation to the cent. Proposes entries for a person. Never posts.

light.reason: Waiting for review: draft package ready, open items remain

task.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Bank Reconciliation Workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned Bank Reconciliation Memo with every reconciling item, its rule and its proposed entry
task.gates: Draft reconciliation. A person decides every item. Nothing is posted.
